analyses.outcome_group: Sensitivity of Patoc-antigen lateral-flow assay diagnosis of acute human leptospirosis

rules: Select only patient-level acute-leptospirosis versus no-leptospirosis records with source-supported TP, FP, FN, and TN.
Select at most one diagnostic-accuracy record per independent study cohort.
When one acute index-test result is evaluated against both a contemporaneous and a later paired-sample reference standard, use the contemporaneous reference-standard record for the primary analysis.
Use source counts rather than a review forest value or an unlinked percentage.

method_selection_policy: After identifying eligible independent evidence, select and justify a synthesis approach from the study data. The participant package does not prescribe a computation method.
